question: Who is qualified to perform the consecration of the weapon-formed deity?
premises: The consecration of the weapon is the topic
An agent is introduced by a relative pronoun
The act is prescribed in optative form
inference: Whoever performs the consecration in this manner does so for the deity in weapon form.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of astramūrtinaḥ is slightly ambiguous
plain_english: Thus, whoever would perform the consecration of the weapon for the one whose form is the weapon.
